title: pvSelectionQuerySource
body:
## pvSelectionQuerySource

Creates a query selection, ParaView's "Find Data" mechanism: QueryString is a structured query over the input's arrays, element indices or locations, evaluated per element when pvExtractSelection (or another extractor) runs; the elements where it is true are selected. ElementType chooses cells (ParaView default) or points, and Selectors can restrict the query to some blocks of a composite input. The output is a vtkSelection (no geometry) for the Selection port of pvExtractSelection or pvAnnotateSelection. For a plain range on one array, pvThresholdSelectionSource is simpler.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- ParaView evaluates query text as Python (vtkPythonSelector, paraview.detail.calculator), so Schemaxis accepts only the structured QueryString, generates the text itself and checks it again before assignment; the selection still needs a ParaView build with Python and numpy.
- Leave ContentType at 9 (QUERY) and FieldTypeOption at 1; the other values make this source produce a different, empty selection type.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `SelectionQuerySource`. Identity: `sources/SelectionQuerySource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Assembly` | Select which assembly is used when specify selectors to choose blocks to show for composite datasets. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ContainingCells` | When field type is POINT, this controls whether single vertex cells will be produced for each selected point, or whether the cells that contain each selected point will be produced. When field type is CELL this has no effect. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ContentType` | Native vtkSelectionNode content-type code of the produced selection: 0 GLOBALIDS, 1 PEDIGREEIDS, 2 VALUES, 3 INDICES, 4 FRUSTUM, 5 LOCATIONS, 6 THRESHOLDS, 7 BLOCKS, 8 BLOCK_SELECTORS, 9 QUERY, 10 USER. Only 9 makes this source emit the query; the other types need ID or value lists that this proxy cannot supply. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `ElementType` | Kind of element the query selects. Chosen by the ParaView entry text: "Point Data", "Cell Data", "Vertex Data", "Edge Data" or "Row Data". This source has no input, so all five texts are always accepted; ParaView checks the element type against the data only when the selection is extracted. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Point Data","Cell Data","Vertex Data","Edge Data","Row Data"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Point Data"` |
| `FieldTypeOption` | Which property decides the element association: 1 uses ElementType (vtkDataObject attribute codes), 0 uses vtkSelectionSource's own FieldType, which this proxy does not expose and which stays at its VTK default, CELL. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `HierarchicalIndex` | Zero-based dataset (box) index within the AMR level given by HierarchicalLevel, restricting the query to that box of an overlapping-AMR input. The restriction is applied only when both HierarchicalLevel and HierarchicalIndex are 0 or greater; -1 means no restriction. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `HierarchicalLevel` | Zero-based AMR refinement level to which the query is restricted, together with HierarchicalIndex; both must be 0 or greater for the restriction to apply. -1 means all levels. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `InsideOut` | When this property is false the selection describes everything that should be extracted. When this is true the selection describes everything that should NOT be extracted. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `NumberOfLayers` | Specify the number of layers of connected elements to include in the selection. | `{"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |
| `ProcessID` | Zero-based MPI rank whose data the query is limited to; -1 applies it on every process. In a serial run there is only rank 0, so -1 and 0 behave alike. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `QueryString` | The elements to select, written as a structured query instead of Python text. "any" lists alternative groups; each group's "all" lists clauses that must all hold; each clause applies one test to an array, an array component or magnitude, or the element index. Schemaxis compiles it to ParaView's Find Data expression and checks the result again before assignment. | `{"properties":{"any":{"items":{"properties":{"all":{"items":{"properties":{"array":{"maxLength":256,"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"component":{"maximum":255,"minimum":0,"type":"integer"},"ids":{"type":"boolean"},"magnitude":{"type":"boolean"},"maximum":{"type":"number"},"minimum":{"type":"number"},"negate":{"type":"boolean"},"point":{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"},"test":{"required":true,"type":"enum","values":["==","!=","<","<=",">",">=","between","oneOf","isMinimum","isMaximum","isMinimumPerBlock","isMaximumPerBlock","isNaN","atMostMean","atLeastMean","nearMean","pointNear","cellContaining"]},"tolerance":{"minimum":0,"type":"number"},"value":{"type":"number"},"values":{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":256,"minItems":1,"type":"array"}},"type":"object"},"maxItems":16,"minItems":1,"required":true,"type":"array"}},"type":"object"},"maxItems":16,"minItems":1,"required":true,"type":"array"}},"type":"object"}` | `required` | `{"any":[{"all":[{"test":"=="}]}]}` |
| `RemoveIntermediateLayers` | When using NumberOfLayers, this controls if intermediate layers are removes or not. Default is false. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `RemoveSeed` | When using NumberOfLayers, this controls if the initial seed selection is remove or not. Default is false. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Selectors` | For composite datasets, specify selectors to limit the view to a chosen subset of blocks. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvSelectionQuerySource",
  "options": {
    "QueryString": {
      "any": [
        {
          "all": [
            {
              "test": "=="
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```
